verdict.summary_en: Boise Semiconductor order acknowledgement OA26397296 for Soony Interactive GmbH PO 4500318787 (dated 2026-11-10). It confirms two lines: item 00020 CMP-GAM-002, 5,500 at 6.11 USD, confirmed 2026-12-11; and item 00010 CMP-GAM-001, 52,000 at 10.93 USD, confirmed 2026-12-16. Terms are EXW Boise, payment NET30. There are no handwritten corrections or stamps.
red_flags: Delivery terms are internally inconsistent: the document says EXW Boise and 'DDP is not agreed', but also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays for these, so the invoice could include charges beyond the unit prices.
The document gives no ordered quantity, so it can't be compared with the confirmed quantities. The 'Qty' column is taken as the confirmed quantity.
The document has no issue date. 2026-11-10 is the date of the customer's order, not of the acknowledgement.
observations: Clean, typed single-page document with no handwriting, stamps, signatures or damage.
Line items are listed out of order (00020 before 00010).
Numbers use English formatting (comma for thousands, period for decimals).
No line totals, currency total, or supplier part numbers are shown.
